name: Cicciano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cicciano (a cross on red above a hand on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cicciano, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cicciano arms — cross on red above a hand on blue, crowned, within branches
